versions.content: API Function Header File Description Fr If _ Get Cycle - Length Fr If.h This API returns the configured time of the configuration parameter "Gd Cycle" in nanoseconds for the Flex Ray controller with index Fr If_ Ctrl Idx. Fr If _ Get Macrotick - Duration Fr If.h Retrieves the Duration of a Macrotick in ns Fr If _ Get State Fr If.h Get current Fr If state. Stb M _ Get Current - Virtual Local Time Stb M.h Returns the Virtual Local Time of the referenced Time Base.
